<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurer" name="Insurer" processRef="Process_Recourse"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CollectionAgency" name="Collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequestPayment" name="Request for payment" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Payment" messageRef="Msg_Payment" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Disagreement" name="Disagreement" messageRef="Msg_Disagreement" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Referral_Wrong" name="Referral" messageRef="Msg_CollectionReferral" sourceRef="Task_ForwardWrong" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Referral_Deadline" name="Referral" messageRef="Msg_CollectionReferral" sourceRef="Task_ForwardDeadline" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Recourse handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Info" name="Information about possible subrogation received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check recourse case"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Recourse" name="Recourse possible?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseNoRecourse" name="Close case"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoRecourse" name="Case closed without recourse"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send request for payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateReminder" name="Create reminder"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="GW_Wait" name="Wait for insurant response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Payment" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Payment" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disagreement" messageRef="Msg_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Deadline" name="Deadline for disagreement reached">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_Deadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BookPayment" name="Book payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAfterPayment" name="Close case"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Paid" name="Case closed after payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ReasoningCorrect" name="Reasoning correct?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseReasoningRight" name="Close case"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReasoningRight" name="Case closed, insurant right"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardWrong" name="Forward case to collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyWrong" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardDeadline" name="Forward case to collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyDeadline" name="Case forwarded after missed deadline"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_Info" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Check_GW" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="GW_Recourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_GW_Request" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Recourse" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_GW_CloseNo" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Recourse" targetRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CloseNo_End" sourceRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse" targetRef="End_NoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Request_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Reminder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_CreateReminder" targetRef="GW_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Wait_Payment" sourceRef="GW_Wait" targetRef="Catch_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Wait_Disagreement" sourceRef="GW_Wait" targetRef="Catch_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Wait_Deadline" sourceRef="GW_Wait" targetRef="Catch_Deadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Payment_Book" sourceRef="Catch_Payment" targetRef="Task_BookPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Book_Close" sourceRef="Task_BookPayment" targetRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Close_EndPaid" sourceRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment" targetRef="End_Paid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Disagreement_Check" sourceRef="Catch_Disagreement" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Check_Reasoning_GW" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="GW_ReasoningCorrect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Reasoning_Right" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Task_CloseReasoningRight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CloseRight_End" sourceRef="Task_CloseReasoningRight" targetRef="End_ReasoningRight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Reasoning_Wrong" name="No" sourceRef="GW_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Task_ForwardWrong"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ForwardWrong_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardWrong" targetRef="End_AgencyWrong"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Deadline_Forward" sourceRef="Catch_Deadline" targetRef="Task_ForwardDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ForwardDeadline_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardDeadline" targetRef="End_AgencyDeadline"/>
  </bpmn:process>
